name: General Store
subtitle: Supplies for the rugged frontier life.

props.label: Town Square
props.note: This passage in the lower middle part of the room leads to Town Square. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

props.label: Katie
props.note: Talk, trade, or follow a story with Katie.

props.label: checkerboard stool
props.note: Checkerboard stool, in the lower right part of the room, beside the stocked timber general store. Choose sit here to settle into this seat.

description: The frontier general store is a dense arrangement of wooden shelves, a long counter and barrels of supplies. Jars, tins, parcels and bottles fill the upper and left walls; hanging bundles and stacked boxes occupy the stock area behind the counter. A small rug brightens the open floor. In the lower foreground, barrels display colourful produce and dry goods, while crates marked Ammo stand to the right of the counter. A small checkerboard and its stool sit nearby. Oil lamps give the timber interior an amber glow, and a rear opening is marked Storage.

landmarks.label: General-store counter
landmarks.description: A long wooden counter with papers and small goods divides the customer floor from the shelves.

landmarks.label: Produce and dry-goods barrels
landmarks.description: Open barrels of colourful produce and dry goods crowd the lower-left foreground.

landmarks.label: Ammunition crates
landmarks.description: Wooden crates marked Ammo are stacked beside the counter.

landmarks.label: Rear storage doorway
landmarks.description: An opening behind the counter carries a Storage sign; it is part of the painted shop interior.

landmarks.label: Checkerboard table
landmarks.description: A small checkerboard is painted near the lower-right edge beside an authored stool.
